title: A stale output file was treated as proof that a productive worker had stalled

source.evidence_note: Observed local historical transcript; see evidence/incident.md. Source aliases map privately; Submission of these prepared files was authorized on 2026-10-11.

horizon.intervening_work: Parallel documentation fact-finding and task monitoring. Earlier attempts had genuinely ended or stalled, which made suspicion reasonable but did not establish that the current worker was stalled.
horizon.mechanism: Observed liveness inference from one stale output channel; current repository progress was checked only after stopping the worker. Long-horizon causation is untested.

failure.expected_behavior: Finish the implementation, then write a comprehensive design document.
failure.observed_behavior: The coordinator found a small output file with an old timestamp and an empty task listing, stopped the implementation subagent, then inspected Git and discovered four new commits plus work in progress.
failure.target_predicate: See checks/README.md; task completion and target error are assessed separately.

comparison_note: No model attempt or causal control has run. A scripted faulty fixture and correct reference, where recorded, validate the checker only.
